output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_over_50k_revenue_2025
FROM (
    SELECT o.customer_id
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    WHERE o.is_revenue = true
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(o.net_revenue) > 50000
) AS c;
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue of completed orders (is_revenue = true). I filtered to orders dated in 2025, summed net_revenue per customer, and counted customers whose 2025 total exceeds 50,000 EUR. Fiscal year equals calendar year, so no adjustment is needed.
